<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. The spectrum should list the chemical shifts and, typically, the integration values for each set of equivalent protons. Methyl groups appear as signals around 0.8–1.2 ppm and correspond to three equivalent protons in the integration. By counting how many such three‑proton signals are present, I can report the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
